scope: packet-only architecture proposals; tools/MCP disabled; runtime NOT_RUN
summary: Recommendation: the PO should select INT-A, a transport-only local harness. It is a test-only, server-side runner in the frontend repo that uses the frontend's HTTP client. It calls the unchanged, C01-accepted Go native /api/v1/users routes at 52b60a4, which run on a fresh disposable loopback PostgreSQL. It proves only local client→REST→Go→PostgreSQL compatibility: problem+json classification, native 503 outage/recovery without false success or empty results, native ETag/412 CAS, persistence across restarts, and X-Request-Id correlation. It adds no backend change, no route, page or screen, and no Task-to-User alias. It uses no session bypass, demo or anonymous mode, or shared token. Authentication, authorization and Workspace/Matter isolation are explicitly excluded and remain product gates. INT-B (authenticated temporary harness) is not recommended; fail-closed conditions are specified in case the PO chooses it anyway. INT-C (defer) is the fallback. The analysis covers proposal decisions INT-D01 to D09 (integration scope; identity; authorization/isolation; hosting H1-H5; adapter F1-F4; PostgreSQL/storage/recovery; retention; workload/cost; product error conventions), each with all 16 fields. It also covers the C01-NATIVE vs C01-PRODUCT boundary and a minimal PO package with no production, IdP, paid or $0 commitments. Limitations: packet-only; http-client.ts and test-runner behavior are unverified; all tests are NOT_RUN; the architecture documents remain candidate and not PO-approved; local results do not prove Cloudflare viability or cost.
